verdict.rationale: Unleash Edge is documented as a lightweight caching layer and read replica that serves thousands of connected SDKs, built for scalability and resilience. It connects to upstream with backend tokens, and targeting data is processed inside the Edge node and never sent upstream, so SDK traffic stays in the customer's network. missing for 10: explicit documentation that flags keep being served while the upstream vendor is unreachable (only implied by 'resilience'), clarity on whether Edge requires the Enterprise tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
